scenario: [LEXP.3.7.4]'s other side: `x.bits(lo, 8)` with a run-time `lo` is not refused, since some `lo` places it inside the domain; a bad one is the engine's DOMAIN fault (`logical/LEXP.3.7.4_out_of_domain_traps`). `s.x.bits(s.lo, 8)` with the constant width 8 compiles. A check that refused every call with a non-constant argument, or that took 8 as out of range, would refuse it. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate.lexp_3_7_4_bit_field_range`.
rules_ds:
schema Sensor scope logical:
    id: String key
    x: Int mutable
    lo: Int mutable

rule r:
    Sensor s where s.x.bits(s.lo, 8) > 0
->
    log info "x"
